tasks.completion_summary: Added server-side wrong-key detection (arguments/args/input -> parameters) to slop-mcp execute_tool with 5 TDD tests; fixed plugin docs with corrected examples and Common Errors table.

Extracted agent prompt injection to internal/agentadapter (Adapter interface + DefaultRegistry), removed duplicated isClaudeCommand/isKnownAIAgent from run.go/run_windows.go, wired ai.adapters KDL overrides (disabled/flag-name/stdin-delay-ms), added docs/agent-adapters.md. make test green; go vet clean.

Auto-generate __devtool API catalog from JSDoc. New scripts/gen-apidocs.go parses @devtool blocks in internal/proxy/scripts/*.js into internal/tools/apidocs_gen.go (84 functions). Seeded api-jsdoc.js from the legacy hardcoded catalog; trimmed apidocs.go from 896 to ~150 lines (structs + accessors + Categories). Added apidocs_drift_test.go to fail CI on drift, Makefile generate/generate-check targets, and //go:generate directive. make test green; go vet clean.

Appended __devtool helpers cheat sheet (~15 helpers, 30 lines) to buildAgntSystemPrompt so every adapter (Claude flag, stdin, agnt ai REPL) gets identical content. New internal/agntprompt package with hardcoded PromotedFunctions slice. Added ai.helpers-cheat-sheet KDL toggle (default true). Tests cover header presence, line budget, adapter parity, config toggle, and catalog drift. make test green; go vet clean; drift check passes.

Added agnt hook check-bash / check-prompt / rules subcommands. New internal/hookrules package: 9 compiled built-in bash regexes + 2 prompt regexes. KDL override via HookRulesConfig. BenchmarkCheckBash = 233 ns/op. 11-row regression corpus + 10 CLI integration tests. docs/hook-rules.md.
Verified that search+category params for proxy exec were fully implemented. make test + go vet clean.
Rewrote proxy tool description for discovery-first workflow. New shared ProxyToolDescription const. Three tests verify ordering, absence of raw calls, and 80-line budget.

Added anti-pattern hint scanner for proxy exec raw JS. New internal/tools/exec_hints.go with 10-rule table. ProxyInput.Hints *bool field (nil=true default). ProxyOutput.ExecHints []string. 23 tests. make test green; go vet clean.
Added --password-store=basic to all Chromium launch paths. Added --use-mock-keychain on darwin. 6 tests. make test + go vet clean.
